implementation: Curve and surface-edge inputs share immutable CapturedCurve references. The nearest geometric endpoint supplies the outward tangent. The nonuniform linear NURBS capture has picked parameter 0.3901 but selects the spatially nearer end.

Default Extension reuses CircularArc3::try_from_start_tangent_end. The center is projected with the existing endpoint normal frame; angle and cursor sweeps reuse the Tilted getter from an oriented circle.

Physical Center endpoints use the shared start-ray direction state, including captured initial cursor inputs. Read-only previews and completion use the same constructors and optional Deformable conversion.

Interactive source picks temporarily replace selection. Completion and cancellation release picks, including previous preselection. One Arc geometry history entry owns successful output; no helpers are added.

Captured-source changes in geometry, visibility, locking, deletion or document tolerance reset the picker. Tests verify source storage sharing, center projection, preview/commit agreement and retry/cancellation.

Source selection sets the relative point base to the chosen endpoint. The native prior-point recipe and its resulting curve establish this semantic rule; production computes the base from the source endpoint, not expected output coordinates.
input_calibration: Public viewport ray projections locate source inputs and final Center endpoint directions. The initial cursor is read before a requested move. Expected output geometry never supplies production inputs.
raw_capture_policy: Basic preserves initial rows [0,1,3,5] unchanged. Typed Center endpoints time out; entering Length at its endpoint starts the global measurement command and times out. Both remain raw diagnostics.
Center numeric preserves center rows [0,3]. The first two physical Center endpoints lack initial cursor receipts and remain diagnostic; the complete center_cursor capture qualifies in full.
Selection preserves diagnostics rows [0,2]. The collinear default endpoint row [1] reports native Arc Failure and no object with clean input. It is not relabeled as a native cancellation.
All eight source, one end-choice and one relative-base rows qualify unchanged. Source and expected-output artifacts are immutable; tests verify exact subset identity.
limitations: Typed native Center endpoint input and exact invalid-input error/termination behavior remain unqualified. Physical endpoint parity uses independent mouse receipts.
The captured Rhino 8 Extension Center getter accepts endpoint/angle input. Length enters the global measurement command; this implementation does not offer an Extension length getter.
Exhaustive pointer trajectories, endpoint ties, zero-derivative and closed-source native error behavior, snapping/filter combinations, camera coverage and performance parity remain unqualified.
